historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a cradle of civilization and seat of Abbasid Caliphate's Baghdad Golden Age, Iraq has had significant regional impact on Islamic culture, trade, and politics. Its tumultuous modern history includes the Iran-Iraq War, Gulf War 1991, US invasion 2003, and sectarian civil war, shaping its current trajectory.
